confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors follow Dubai cost-of-living averages of about AED 47 for an inexpensive meal, AED 300 for two, AED 22 for cappuccino, and AED 50 for draft beer. Cocktail and wine estimates use local bar-price relationships to beer and are less certain. July accommodation anchors are holistic summer low-season estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and beer anchors use Dubai-specific aggregated prices; accommodation estimates reflect Dubai's summer tourism market.
